prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW background for a native Unity Chinese New Year roguelike card game, using image 1 ONLY as a STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE. Match its detailed premium pixel-art / 32-bit RPG illustration quality: discrete carefully placed pixel clusters, refined snow, vermilion architecture, warm glowing amber lanterns, plum blossoms, indigo and lavender winter twilight, joyful welcoming festival mood. Not chunky crude blocks, not photorealistic, not horror. Wide 16:9 composition. NO characters, monsters, cards, UI, frames, buttons, route nodes, paths drawn for gameplay, letters, logos or readable text. Create original new scenery, not a copy of the reference scene. Keep decorative detail at the outer edges and distant scenery, with deliberate quiet areas for the actual game UI. Asset type: CHARACTER SELECTION backdrop. A beautiful lantern-lit temple courtyard prepared for three guardians to depart on New Year's Eve. Low carved red railings and warm lantern pavilions at far left and far right; snow-dusted plum branches only at top corners; far mountains and welcoming warm temple lights in the upper background. The middle and lower LEFT TWO THIRDS must be an EMPTY wide stone platform for THREE actual playable characters to be overlaid, with ample clear space from 25% to 80% image height and simple subtly shaded paving. All three characters' feet will be at 79% image height. The RIGHTMOST 30% needs a subdued uncluttered wall/curtain surface behind a character information panel. The top 12% and bottom 12% should remain quiet for title and controls. No large foreground lanterns, no lantern strings through the character silhouettes.
